probe: compositional portability (same-relation reworded vs same-subject different-relation)
diagnosis: INLAY's MiniLM prompt-embedding gate is dominated by subject/topic; same-subject different-relation queries score as high as genuine paraphrases (gate cosine same_mean 0.816 vs other_mean 0.749, overlapping). So INLAY plays back the edit on the wrong query 97% of the time.
fix: relation gate — at read time compare the query's relation-residual (query embedding minus the SLOT's stored subject direction) to the slot's; fire only if it clears rel_gate. Subject known at write time, so NO read-time NER; stays zero-gradient.
honest_conclusion: The relation gate is a genuine PARTIAL mitigation (over-fire 0.97->0.67), not a free fix: it costs CounterFact paraphrase generalization (PS 0.87->0.66) because reworded paraphrases and different-relation queries are both moves away from the exact written prompt. This over-firing is the structural signature of a retrieval-not-rederivation method and is INLAY's genuine remaining weakness.
